figurative_meaning_en: To make a promise or commitment
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমি তোমাকে কথা দিচ্ছি যে আমি সাহায্য করব।
সে তার বন্ধুকে কথা দিয়েছে যে সে সময়মতো পৌঁছে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: I give you my word that I will help you.
He gave his friend his word that he would arrive on time.
note: Emphasizes the cultural value of honoring promises in Bengali society
